products.fullDescription: Portable Cervical Thermal Ablation ThermocoagulatorThe Portable Cervical Thermal Ablation Thermocoagulator is a compact, battery-powered handheld thermal coagulation device designed for controlled thermal treatment of cervical pre-cancerous lesions and other indicated tissue lesions. Its cordless design makes it suitable for use in hospitals, clinics, screening programs, and healthcare environments where access to mains electricity may be limited.The device uses a heated probe tip to deliver controlled thermal energy directly to the intended treatment area. With automated treatment timing, adjustable temperature and treatment-duration settings, and interchangeable probes, it is designed to provide a practical and portable solution for healthcare professionals performing thermal ablation procedures. Rapid Heating: Exchangeable probes reach the selected treatment temperature in approximately 5–8 seconds.	Default Therapy: 100°C for 20 seconds, with selectable treatment times and temperatures. Exchangeable Probes: Available probe configurations include 16 mm flat, 19 mm flat, and 19 mm pointed tips. Designed for Portable Thermal AblationThe thermocoagulator combines a compact handheld design with controlled thermal energy delivery. It is intended for use by appropriately trained healthcare professionals and can support treatment in both conventional clinical environments and locations where portability is important.The heated probe tip is designed to contact only the tissue intended for treatment. The probe shaft and sidewall are designed to remain substantially cooler than the heated treatment surface, helping distinguish the active treatment area from the rest of the probe. Heated Probe TechnologyThe treatment probe incorporates an integrated heating element. On the default setting, the active probe tip heats to 100°C (212°F) for the programmed treatment cycle.A typical default cycle consists of:Approx. 5–8 seconds heating → 20 seconds treatment at 100°C → approx. 10 seconds coolingThe treatment parameters can be adjusted according to the device's available settings and the clinical protocol being followed. Available configurations include:	16 mm Flat Tip	19 mm Flat Tip	19 mm Pointed TipThe probes are designed for rapid heating and can be autoclaved for sterilization when processed according to the applicable manufacturer's validated sterilization instructions.Portable Battery-Powered OperationA rechargeable lithium-ion battery eliminates the need for a continuous external power connection during treatment. This makes the device particularly practical for mobile healthcare programs, clinics, screening environments, and locations where conventional power infrastructure may be limited. Battery System	Rechargeable lithium-ion battery	3-cell, 2 Ah battery pack	Battery Management System (BMS)	Overcharge protection	Approx. 2-hour charging time

products.fullDescription: The Electro-Surgical Skin Cautery Unit is a precision-engineered medical device designed for dermatological, cosmetic, and plastic surgical procedures. It delivers high-frequency monopolar and bipolar currents, enabling safe and effective coagulation, desiccation, and fulguration. The portable briefcase design ensures easy transport and safe storage, making it an ideal choice for clinics and hospitals alike.This unit is specially crafted to handle a wide range of minor surgical applications such as the removal of skin tags, warts, corns, cysts, and small tumors. It also supports advanced procedures like collagen remodeling, non-ablative skin treatments, epilation, nipple and forehead lifts, and hair restoration surgeries.Thanks to its accurate intensity control (50–100W), user-friendly interface, and exceptional safety features, this cautery device delivers excellent cosmetic results with minimal side effects and quicker patient recovery. Perfect for dermatologists, E.N.T specialists, plastic surgeons, general surgeons, and cosmetologists. Applications		Dermatology & Cosmetic Treatments			Skin tag, wart, cyst & lesion removal			Hair restoration & facial lifts			Collagen remodeling and epilation			Plastic and reconstructive surgeries			Tumor and keloid ablation			Palatoplasty, blepharoplasty, mamoplasty			Minor biopsies and abdominoplasty			ENT & oral surgeries (tongue lesion, epistaxis, etc.)			Skin flap development and aesthetic procedures	 Special Features		Monopolar & bipolar current options			Compact briefcase design for portability			Precision-controlled intensity (50W–100W)			Ideal for coagulation, desiccation, fulguration			Safe for both invasive & non-invasive skin procedures			Minimal tissue damage, no charring, and quick healing			Excellent cosmetic results with reduced downtime	 Technique OverviewThe unit operates using focused high-frequency waves that pass through interchangeable electrodes tailored for specific procedures. When activated, the waves heat intracellular water, converting it to steam, and gently dissolve tissue cells. The process ensures a clean, controlled incision or coagulation with minimal trauma. Output intensity can be finely tuned based on procedural depth and sensitivity, making it a superior alternative to conventional diathermy.

products.fullDescription: The Digital Cautery 400W Electro Surgical Generator is a medical device used in surgical procedures for various purposes including cutting, coagulation, and hemostasis. Here are some detailed aspects of its use:		Power Output and Modes:			The generator typically outputs up to 400 watts of power, which can be adjusted based on the requirements of the surgical procedure.		It offers different modes such as cut, coagulation (including spray coagulation), blend, and bipolar modes.				Cut Mode:			In cut mode, the generator provides a high-frequency electrical current that allows for precise cutting of tissues. This mode is used for making clean incisions.				Coagulation Modes:			Standard Coagulation: Provides a consistent level of coagulation suitable for controlling bleeding during surgery.		Spray Coagulation: Dispenses the electrical current in a spray-like pattern, useful for covering a larger surface area to achieve hemostasis.				Blend Mode:			Combines cutting and coagulation functionalities, providing a simultaneous cutting and coagulating effect. This mode is often used in surgeries where both functions are required in quick succession.				Bipolar Mode:			Used for delicate surgeries where precise control over the coagulation is necessary, such as in neurosurgery or ophthalmic procedures.		Bipolar mode uses two closely spaced electrodes, reducing the risk of unintended tissue damage and allowing for more controlled coagulation.				User Interface:			The generator features a digital interface that allows surgeons to adjust settings such as power output, mode selection, and activation.		Some models may include pre-set programs for common surgical procedures, enhancing efficiency and consistency.				Safety Features:			Includes safety mechanisms such as alarms for errors or improper usage.		Ensures patient safety by monitoring parameters like impedance and temperature to prevent tissue damage.				Applications:			The Digital Cautery 400W Electro Surgical Generator is used across various surgical specialties including general surgery, orthopedic surgery, plastic surgery, and more.		It aids in procedures ranging from simple skin incisions to complex organ surgeries where precise cutting and effective hemostasis are critical.				Accessories:			Typically used with disposable electrodes and accessories specific to different surgical needs.		Electrodes come in various shapes and sizes to accommodate different surgical requirements.		 		Overall, the Digital Cautery 400W Electro Surgical Generator is an essential tool in modern surgery, providing surgeons with the capabilities needed for precise tissue management, hemostasis, and minimizing surgical risks. Its advanced features and user-friendly interface contribute to improved surgical outcomes and patient care.

Brian Clark•Jun 17, 2025Rated 5 out of 5 stars.The Journey to Full Recovery ContinuesToday is Day 9 Post-Op for my Total Knee Replacement Surgery. I am getting better with each passing day. This is Day 7 of treatments on the CPM (Continuous Passive Motion) machine. This machine increases the range of motion in my knee to prevent it from becoming stiff and locking up after surgery. When I started the treatments the range was set at 60 degrees, today it is set at 95 degrees. The range is increased by 5 degrees each day. The goal is 120 degrees, so I still have some work to do, but it is necessary if I want to regain the strength and flexibility in my knee. Each day I spend 4 hours on the CPM machine (2 hours in the morning and 2 hours at night). The good thing is the machine keeps on working my knee, even if I fall a sleep. 😴n addition to the CPM machine treatments, I have exercises to do 2-3 times a day, provided to me by my inhome physical therapist. In between treatments and exercises I ice the knee down to help reduce the swelling. My wife, Sylvia, has been my coach and comforter during this process. SHE HAS BEEN TRULY AMAZING!! THANK YOU Sweetheart !! Well the journey has not been easy, but it is necessary for me to reach Full Recovery!! The journey to Full Recovery Continues!!
